sources.name: ZecScope /api/v1/daily (measured node value pools, one row per UTC day since genesis)
ZecStats /api/zec/pools.csv (own daily snapshot archive, CC BY 4.0)

priceSource: Binance ZECUSDT spot daily close (data-api.binance.vision); today = live CoinGecko

levels.note: Level correlations between two trending series are usually spurious (both drift over time), so the p-value here is NOT meaningful on its own. Use the change-based and cointegration tests below.

weekly.leadLagNote: lagWeeks > 0 = shielded flow this week vs price return L weeks LATER (flow leads); < 0 = price return L weeks EARLIER vs this week's flow (price leads). Non-overlapping weeks.

cointegration.method: Engle-Granger: OLS log(price) = a + b*log(shielded), ADF(7 lags, constant) on residuals
cointegration.read: No cointegration at 5%: the long-run level relationship is not statistically stable, so level-based projections below are fragile.

flags.text: Shielding is accelerating: last 7 days averaged 4,380 ZEC/day vs 2,362 ZEC/day over 30 days.

signal.note: Net flow = day-over-day change in total shielded supply (Sprout+Sapling+Orchard+Ironwood). Pool-to-pool migrations (e.g. Orchard->Ironwood) net to zero. z-scores use overlapping rolling windows, so they overstate rarity a little.

walkForward90d.note: Refit monthly on data up to that date, predict the price 90 days later using the shielded supply that actually happened (i.e. the error you get even when you guess the shielded supply right).

loglog.explain: log(price) = -2.67 + 0.50 x log(shielded ZEC), fit on daily data since 2020. Low/high = 5th/95th percentile of historical misses around the line (empirical band, not a formal confidence interval: the misses are strongly autocorrelated).

loglog1y.explain: Same log-log line fit on the last 365 days only (the post-2025 regime): log(price) = 28.16 + -1.43 x log(shielded). Very short sample; a slope this size mostly reflects the 2025-26 rally, not a stable law. NOT USED in the scenario table: slope -1.43 (<=0) and/or R2 0.03 (<0.10) means there is no usable price-vs-shielded relationship inside the last year.

ratio.explain: Market cap per shielded ZEC (= price / shielded share). Implied price = ratio x target shielded ZEC / current supply. Low/base/high = 10th/50th/90th percentile of the ratio actually observed.

scenarios.label: SCENARIOS, NOT PREDICTIONS. They answer "if shielded supply were X and the market valued it the way it has before". Shielded supply does not cause price; the two have trended together. Uses current supply (it grows ~1,800 ZEC/day).

caveats: Shielded and price both trend: level correlations are mostly common drift. Only the change-based tests, Granger tests and the cointegration test say anything about co-movement.
Ironwood (NU6.3, active since block 3,428,143 on 2026-07-28 per ZecStats/ZecZcash) is counted as shielded on the same basis as Sprout/Sapling/Orchard.
Exchange/custodian behaviour (e.g. an exchange moving reserves into a shielded pool) can move shielded supply without any change in end-user demand.
Daily rows are end-of-UTC-day pool balances; ZecScope covers genesis..2026-09-17, ZecStats from 2026-07-30; overlap agreement is reported in sourceOverlapCheck.
p-values assume independent observations; daily crypto returns have fat tails and volatility clustering, so treat p near 0.05 as weak evidence.
nfa: Research from free public data. Not financial advice.
